title: Reading power and adult intervention at sponsor gathering
context: Children of influential sponsors quarrel; Nogi uses family power and intimidation
information_available: Adults observing, unequal family influence, open threats, ambiguous assertion about an autograph

alternate_outcomes_to_test: Without adults, witnesses or funding dependencies his leverage differs.
